hero.title: Uzbekistan Red Crescent Society
hero.subtitle: One of the oldest organizations in Uzbekistan, dedicated to humanitarian aid, emergency response, and community service since 1925.

about.label: About Us
about.title: A Legacy of Compassion
about.description: The Uzbekistan Red Crescent Society has been serving the people of Uzbekistan for nearly a century. As part of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent Movement, we are committed to protecting human life and health, and to ensuring respect for all human beings.
about.intro_society: As one of the oldest humanitarian organizations, the society unites thousands of volunteers across all regions, operating a network of regional offices, a training center, and numerous programs in first aid, blood donation, emergency response, and community service.

medical.title: Medical & Social Services
medical.desc: Blood donation drives, health promotion, and social welfare programs for vulnerable communities.

emergency.title: Emergency Response
emergency.desc: Disaster preparedness, emergency relief operations, and rapid response teams across all regions.

first_aid.title: First Aid Training
first_aid.desc: Teaching life-saving first aid skills to communities, schools, and organizations nationwide.

donation.title: Blood Donation
donation.desc: Promoting voluntary unpaid blood donation and ensuring safe blood supply for those in need.

volunteer.title: Youth & Volunteering
volunteer.desc: Engaging youth in humanitarian work and building a strong network of dedicated volunteers.

law.title: International Humanitarian Law
law.desc: Disseminating knowledge about Geneva Conventions and international humanitarian principles.

live.title: Regional Offices
live.subtitle: Our Red Crescent branches across all regions of Uzbekistan

donate.label: Donate
donate.title: Make a Difference
donate.subtitle: Your donation helps save lives and provide essential aid to those in need around the world.
donate.confirm_message: Your generous donation of {{amount}} so'm will help save lives. Thank you for your support!
donate.transparency: Donations support the humanitarian programs of the Uzbekistan Red Crescent Society. Reports will be published on this site.
